input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4 conditions our convenience termination on "paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — a Customer-payable liquidated amount on termination whose quantum is set entirely outside the Agreement and is therefore uncapped. That fails the fallback (no three-month cap, and no statement that it is the sole liquidated amount payable by us). Deleting the charge outright to reach the preferred position would require collateral rewrites of Section 3.4's lead-in and of the cross-references in Sections 3.3 and 13.1, so we take the fallback: a cap at three months' charges for the terminated Services, expressed as the only liquidated amount payable by Customer, with no other liquidated damages or penalties. No amount is specified in the document, so this is not yet walk-away territory.

mappings.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.

proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges and make them the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.4(b) exposes us to open-ended early termination charges set outside this Agreement. Our position is that we pay no liquidated damages or penalties; as a fallback we accept an early-termination fee capped at three months' charges as the sole liquidated amount payable by us.

ops.text: Early termination charges under this Subsection 3.4(b) will not exceed three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services, and are the only liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement; Customer will pay no other liquidated damages or penalties.
